actual_visual_review.whole_job_cost.png: All sixteen cells and four mode legends readable; fourteen exact successful costs and two failed known-lower-bound bars retained. Unknown usage and accounting incomplete are explicitly labeled. Fixed mode exact totals remain null with a visible explanation.
actual_visual_review.paired_comparisons.png: All five comparisons and twenty paired rows readable with no observed text overlap or clipping. Failure transitions, null aggregates, common-success selection, prefix evidence and false fixed gates are visible. Positive threshold representation cost difference is not labeled a saving.

publication_clarifications.issue: The table heading Actual intervention denotes the fixed comparison-qualified predicate. It is not a direct count or a statement that no delta message was delivered.
publication_clarifications.concrete_example: Task 4 threshold_delta has one delta installation and nine known actor calls containing delta, while its threshold representation pair has prefix_match=false and fixed actual_intervention=false.
publication_clarifications.suggested_caption: Actual intervention is the fixed comparison eligibility predicate. Representation comparisons require both known delta exposure and observed prefix agreement. False therefore need not mean that no delta was delivered; Task 4 threshold/delta had 9 known delta actor calls but did not satisfy prefix agreement.

publication_clarifications.issue: Root viewed nine completed rows before full closure. Historical process-local false flags in original metadata do not establish global operator blinding. Link the separately preserved exposure disclosure; no global blinding claim is made in this review.

claim_limits: Known four-task seed57 development factorial, not independent task replication or a general quality/novelty result.
Null fixed aggregate differences stay null even when a known common-success subset can be described separately.
Positive or negative known-subtotal differences involving unknown calls are not exact whole-job treatment differences.
Representation prefix values and intervention eligibility are compared with the fixed audit; raw prefix evidence and native counts are not independently replayed.
all_activated_representation_prefixes_match=true can be vacuous when no candidate delta actor calls were observed; it is not observed matching-prefix evidence.
Unknown failed runs retain their known costs and cannot support a preserved-quality saving claim.
review_process_note: An initial read-only inspection used the wrong comparison key paired_results and raised KeyError before writing any review artifact. The correct existing key pairs was then used; no producer or renderer was rerun.
